business_summary: OPay Limited provides digital financial services in Singapore, Nigeria, Indonesia, Egypt, and Pakistan. The company operates through two segments: Digital Wallets and Banking, and Credit Business. The company's Digital Wallets and Banking segment offers a consumer wallet for storing value, peer-to-peer transfers, deposits, and withdrawals through the OPay app. It enables cashless payments through QR code scanning, merchant identifiers, USSD, SMS, and the Pay with OPay checkout for online merchants. The company offers the OPay Debit Card. It also enables bill payments for airtime and data top-ups, utilities, television subscriptions, transportation and tolls, school tuition and exam fees, government and tax payments, entertainment, travel, and charitable donations. The company provides in-app mini-app storefronts through OPay Marketplace, allowing users to browse and complete transactions within the app. It offers savings products, including OWealth; SafeBox; Fixed Deposits, fixed-tenor deposit products; Targets, a goal-based savings tool; and Spend & Save, an automated sweep-savings tool. The company provides merchant acquiring services, including online checkout integration, QR and payment-code acceptance, and POS terminals. It also offers business solutions, such as real-time transaction monitoring, automated settlement and reconciliation reports, multi-outlet workflow management, customer engagement and loyalty tools, supplier and staff management modules, fraud and anomaly detection, API-based integrations with merchant ERP and point-of-sale systems, and access to savings and credit products. The company's Credit Business segment provides personal loans in Nigeria through the OPay app, OKash, and EaseMoni; loan facilitation services in Indonesia through RupiahCepat; buy now, pay later credit for in-app purchases and bill payments; and merchant loans for small and micro businesses. OPay Limited was founded in 2017 and is based in Singapore.
business_summary_ko: OPay Limited는 싱가포르, 나이지리아, 인도네시아, 이집트 및 파키스탄에서 디지털 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 디지털 지갑 및 뱅킹, 신용 사업이라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사의 디지털 지갑 및 뱅킹 부문은 OPay 앱을 통해 가치 저장, P2P 송금, 예금 및 인출을 위한 소비자 지갑을 제공합니다. QR 코드 스캔, 판매자 식별자, USSD, SMS 및 온라인 판매자를 위한 Pay with OPay 체크아웃을 통해 현금 없는 결제가 가능합니다. 회사는 OPay 직불 카드를 제공합니다. 또한 방송 시간 및 데이터 충전, 공과금, 텔레비전 구독, 교통 및 통행료, 학교 등록금 및 시험 비용, 정부 및 세금 납부, 엔터테인먼트, 여행 및 자선 기부에 대한 청구서를 지불할 수 있습니다. 회사는 OPay Marketplace를 통해 인앱 미니앱 상점을 제공하여 사용자가 앱 내에서 거래를 탐색하고 완료할 수 있도록 합니다. OWealth를 포함한 저축 상품을 제공합니다. 세이프박스; 정기예금, 정기예금 상품; 목표 기반 저축 도구인 Targets; 자동화된 저축 도구인 지출 및 저축(Spend & Save). 회사는 온라인 체크아웃 통합, QR 및 가맹점 획득 서비스를 제공합니다.
